newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters says no NZ company tax cuts in this term.
newsitem.headline: Peters says no NZ company tax cuts in this term.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters on Wednesday reiterated that it may be possible to cut corporate as well as personal taxes over time.
"I do not rule out circumstances when this country would be able to reduce its corporate tax rate," Peters told parliament's finance and expenditure committee.

However, he said any cuts in corporate tax would be outside the three-year forecast period covered in last week's Budget Policy Statement, which coincides with the term of the centre-right coalition government.
